title: Integration Provider Manifest v1
description: Schema-governed provider manifest for backend-owned integration capability spine. Describes an integration provider (GitHub, Google Drive, etc.) with its capabilities, scopes, permissions, connection states, and safety policies. Future MCP/ACP/IDE extension layers consume these manifests for safe integration exposure.

display_name.description: Human-readable provider name (e.g. GitHub, Google Drive).

description.description: Brief description of the integration provider and its role.

auth_kind.description: Authentication mechanism used by this provider. service_account_not_supported_for_user_flow indicates a future/enterprise path that is explicitly not supported in user-facing flows.

identity_provider_kind.description: If this integration shares an identity provider (e.g. GitHub integration reuses GitHub identity OAuth), reference the IdentityProviderKind. Null if the integration has standalone auth.

connection_states.description: Valid connection state values for this provider.

capability_id.description: Unique capability identifier within the provider (e.g. read_repo_metadata).

kind.description: Capability kind: read (data retrieval), write (mutation), observe (event watching), webhook_ingest (webhook event reception).

gated.description: Whether this capability is gated behind explicit user approval. Write capabilities must be gated by default.

profile_gate_required.description: Whether the profile must be unlocked before this capability is available.

required_scopes.description: OAuth scopes or GitHub App permissions required for this capability.

sensitive_surfaces.description: Data surfaces that are sensitive and must be redacted/hashed in telemetry.

telemetry_safety_class.description: Telemetry safety classification for this capability's output.

mcp_acp_exposable.description: Whether this capability is safe to expose as an MCP/ACP tool. Mutation capabilities must not be exposed while locked/not_configured.

required_scopes_or_permissions.description: Required OAuth scopes or GitHub App permissions for basic provider operation.

sensitive_surfaces.description: Provider-level sensitive data surfaces that must be redacted/hashed in telemetry (e.g. repository_name, file_id, account_id).

telemetry_safety_class.description: Default telemetry safety classification for this provider. content_light = safe for telemetry with hashing. restricted = limited fields only. forbidden = no telemetry.

redaction_policy.description: Redaction policy for telemetry and evidence. hash_all_identifiers = SHA256 all account/repo/file IDs. hash_content_derived = SHA256 all content-derived fields. drop_all_content = no content in telemetry. allow_safe_metadata_only = only non-sensitive metadata.

evidence_paths.description: Relative paths under .rig/ for integration evidence artifacts.

profile_gate_required.description: Whether the first-launch profile gate must be completed before this integration can be configured.

release_gate_required.description: Whether this integration is a release gate blocker. Default false — integrations are optional capabilities.

default_connection_state.description: Initial connection state when no provider configuration exists.
